title: Revisit a finished shiur through its texts and transcript

tasks.title: Connect the recording page to its assets and the end of a recorded room

acs.text: WHEN a recording manifest is ready THE SYSTEM SHALL show its chronological chapters including repeat visits and a bibliography containing each distinct ref once, using the host to open sources beside Social where supported.
scenarios: A class returns to its first text

acs.text: WHEN a ready transcript exists THE SYSTEM SHALL show searchable timestamped excerpts; choosing a timestamp SHALL open the existing player and seek to that time.
scenarios: Search and revisit a transcript moment

acs.text: WHEN assets are processing, absent, unavailable or failed THE SYSTEM SHALL show an appropriate state, retry pending processing, allow retry after a read error and retain recording navigation and controls.
scenarios: A transcript is not yet ready

acs.text: WHEN a viewer opens the page THE SYSTEM SHALL provide Back to Social and Back to room when associated, preserve owner-only deletion and work in English and Hebrew with keyboard controls.
scenarios: Return to Social from a recording

acs.text: WHEN an owner successfully finishes recording while closing the room THE SYSTEM SHALL navigate to that recording's existing page; failed finalization SHALL not navigate to a completed recording or close the room.

WHEN a viewer revisits a class THE SYSTEM SHALL provide section navigation, a visual itinerary, a selectable bilingual source excerpt with an open-in-reader link, and distinct empty states for summary, shared margins, chiddushim, open questions and next learning. Selection must update the displayed source without losing the itinerary. The layout must stack on narrow screens and preserve explicit text language and direction.
scenarios: Revisit the complete class artifact layout
